en.short: This app is not a lawyer. It provides general information about your rights, not legal advice for your specific case.
en.when_to_see_lawyer: If you're being charged with a serious crime; If you're being held in custody and don't know what to do; If your rights are being violated; If you're being asked to sign documents you don't understand

yo.short: Àpù yìí kìí ṣe agbẹjọ́rò. Ó ń fúnni ní ìwífún gbogbogbò nípa ẹ̀tọ́ rẹ, kìí ṣe ìmọ̀ràn òfin fún ọ̀ràn pàtó rẹ.
yo.when_to_see_lawyer: Tí wọ́n bá fi ẹ̀sùn ọ̀daràn ńlá kan kàn ọ́; Tí wọ́n bá fi ọ́ sí àhámọ́ tí o kò sì mọ ohun tí o lè ṣe; Tí wọ́n bá ń rú ẹ̀tọ́ rẹ; Tí wọ́n bá ń béèrè lọ́wọ́ rẹ láti fọwọ́ sí àwọn ìwé tí o kò lóye

ha.short: Wannan manhaja ba lauya ba ce. Yana ba da bayanai na gaba ɗaya game da haƙƙinku, ba shawara ta shari'a ba ga takamaiman shari'arku.
ha.when_to_see_lawyer: Idan ana tuhumar ku da babban laifi; Idan ana tsare ku kuma ba ku san abin da za ku yi ba; Idan ana take haƙƙinku; Idan ana neman ku sanya hannu kan takardu ba ku fahimta ba
